summary: Thai recipe and food media site, six pages, with partial AI-crawler blocks, a stale llms.txt, inconsistent article dates, a double H1 and uneven Recipe markup.

expected_facts.fact: robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot from /recipes/ only (the rest of the site stays open to it), and blocks Google-Extended from the whole site.
GPTBot, PerplexityBot and other crawlers fall under the * group and may crawl everything.
llms.txt lists three recipes, of which /recipes/tom-yum/ and /recipes/pad-thai/ return 404, and it omits the som tam recipe that does exist.
The street-food article's Article markup has dateModified (2026-03-01) earlier than datePublished (2026-07-10), which is impossible.
The som tam recipe page has two H1 elements and no Recipe markup, while the khao soi page has Recipe markup with author, yield, total time and ingredients.
sitemap.xml lists 6 URLs that all return 200.
